text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
* Belgian mineral water group Spadel said its Portuguese unit Empresa Das Aguas Do Alardo had decided to file for bankruptcy.

* The only consortium bidding for Portugal's third mobile phone licence, led by the Sonae group's Inparsa and including state utility EDP, will announce the name of a strategic partner in two weeks, a source linked to the process told the paper.
* Officials of Aeroportos e Navegacao Aerea da Madeira said work to extend Funchal airport in Madeira should be completed in June 2000.
* The government forecasts an average inflation rate below 2.1 percent at the end of this year, according to a forecast of the prime minister's office.
